content:
elaine: heads-up i'm opening a docs PR that bundles a short 'Offline installer -> KMS proxy' migration checklist + examples. main goals: pragmatic troubleshooting, a minimal python sdk proxy example, and a note on MTU/fragmentation for HSM UDP paths. asking for one infra + one docs reviewer.

ben: drop the PR here when ready pls. curious if this changes any of the current installer flags. if so, we should document migration steps separately.

elaine: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987. it does rename an env var: OLD_KMS_PROXY -> KMS_PROXY_URL and adds TLS_CERT_PATH/TLS_KEY_PATH for proxy client certs. i'll add a deprecation callout.

toni: nice. can you also include a short sanity-check script that operators can run in air-gapped environments (no curl to internet)? paste it in the troubleshooting section.

elaine: adding two small checks: 1) tcp connect via proxy (socat) 2) python requests via env var. snippet below.

elaine: """sh
# quick socat check (from inside customer network)
socat - TCP-CONNECT:kms.internal:443,proxyport=3128,proxyauth=user:pass
# returns SSL handshake or connect errors
"""

elaine: and python example: """py
import os, requests
os.environ['HTTPS_PROXY'] = 'http://10.10.0.5:3128'
resp = requests.get('https://kms.internal/healthz', timeout=5)
print(resp.status_code)
"""

ben: good. add note about requests not using system cert store in some distros; include how to pass verify=/path/to/ca.pem.

toni: re: MTU: we should warn that some HSMs talk CMP/UDP and large packets can be dropped when SNATing or with path MTU issues. recommend reducing MTU to 1400 on the egress interface as a troubleshooting step.

elaine: will add a short table of checks: (1) TLS handshake logs, (2) HSM keepalive / UDP probes, (3) key fetch lifecycle logs. sample command for MTU change: ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1400

infra-bot: automated lint: code fences must be triple-backtick and language tag optional. broken linkfinder: none yet.

link-checker: link-check: found anchor mismatch in /installers/airgap_kms.md -> #old-proxy-config. suggested update to #kms-proxy-env or remove reference.

ben: ok replace anchor and add redirect paragraph: "Old flag --use_kms_proxy has been replaced by KMS_PROXY_URL. See migration steps." Also mention timeline for removal.

toni: include an explicit 'rollback' line for installers: how to revert to previous behavior if the new env vars break boot (short step: set KMS_PROXY_URL to blank and restart installer service).

elaine: adding that. splitting PR into two commits: 1) troubleshooting + checks + snippets, 2) link fixes + deprecation/migration note. planning to request reviews from @ben and @toni after tests.

ben: ping ops and security once PR is ready. ops should validate HSM UDP test plan; security to ok the new TLS env var guidance.

toni: i'll run the socat and python checks against our staging offline bundle. will post results and checksum.

elaine: thanks. small follow-up: i added an example nft/iptables pair for SNAT. will keep both, and add a short line about preferring nft on modern distros.

elaine: """
# iptables example
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
# nftables example
nft -- add table ip nat; nft -- add chain ip nat postrouting { type nat hook postrouting priority 100; }
nft add rule ip nat postrouting oifname \"eth0\" masquerade
"""

ben: looks good. keep examples minimal. can we also ship a tiny test plan subsection like: verify key fetch, verify operator logs, validate HSM UDP pings, validate proxy handshake? that helps support.

elaine: done. final step: i'll mark the PR ready and tag reviewers in the morning. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
